title: Campus Vote
summary: A Flask and MySQL web application for campus election voting with student registration, admin election/candidate management, and result tallying. The requirements.txt lists sdv, ctgan, rdt, sdmetrics, and copulas as dependencies, but no code in the application imports or calls any of them.
evidence: requirements.txt: sdv==1.36.1, ctgan==0.12.1, rdt==1.21.0, sdmetrics==0.28.0, copulas==0.14.1; no matching usage in code
needs: Dependency appears unrelated to the app's stated purpose (voting system); likely an unused or copy-pasted requirements file.
